classicCola.name: Classic Cola
classicCola.variant: SAHEB SULTAN'S NEVE COOL Classic Cola
classicCola.description: An authentic Indian spiced cola crafted with purified treated water, effervescent CO2, natural salt, and rich effervescent refreshment.
classicCola.shelfLife: Best Before 3 Months From Date of Mfg.
classicCola.rawIngredients: Treated Water, Sugar, CO2, Natural Salt, Malic-Fumaric Acid, Stabilising Agents.
classicCola.rawDeclarations: Contains : Class II Preservative (211), Synthetic Food Colour (E-150-D), No Fruit Added.
classicCola.allergenNotice: 100% Vegetarian. Contains no common allergens (Gluten-free, Vegan, Nut-free, Dairy-free).
